card.summary: 15 GB of free transfer every month plus 5 days of free storage per package. Credit card with a $10 pre-authorisation required at signup.

free_tier.stated: 15 GB of free transfer every month plus 5 days of free storage per package. Credit card with a $10 pre-authorisation required at signup.

retention.stated: request-rate/quota: 15 GB transfer per calendar month; retention: 5 days free storage per file, then per-GB storage billing; per-GB egress $0.25 after the allowance

egress.terms: Metered after the free allowance: $0.25/GB pay-as-you-go, charged on egress ('when a file exits our network, either as a download to a machine or an upload to connected storage, we apply an egress fee per gigabyte').

record.interface_detail: rest (MASV API / desktop app / S3-adjacent cloud integrations)
record.tooling: official MASV desktop app + API; cloud integrations push to S3/GCS/Azure
record.chaining: 15 GB/month free credit x unlimited free accounts x a valid card each; the card pre-auth is the anti-multiplication gate. Even at 100 accounts that is 1.5 TB/month of transfer, not storage, and every byte over 15 GB bills at $0.25/GB.
record.limits_note: Request-rate/quota: 15 GB transfer per calendar month; retention: 5 days free storage per file, then per-GB storage billing; per-GB egress $0.25 after the allowance. The task brief's '100 GB free' is wrong. It is 15 GB/month (100 GB is the Smash API trial, a different vendor).
record.reliability_note: Files beyond the 5-day free storage window start accruing charges silently; the account auto-transitions to pay-as-you-go rather than stopping.

evidence.proved: 'New customers can sign up and receive 15 GB of transfers each month. You also receive 5 days of free storage per package'

'You receive 15 GB of free data transfer every month ... Pay As You Go at $0.25 USD per GB ... b) You store files beyond the 5 days of free storage per file', 'a valid credit card is required ... $10 pre-authorization charge'

record.notes: 15 GB of free transfer every month plus 5 days of free storage per package. Credit card with a $10 pre-authorisation required at signup.

dead_end.why: 15 GB of free transfer every month plus 5 days of free storage per package. Credit card with a $10 pre-authorisation required at signup.
